purpose: Separate trusted observation horizon provenance from useful-work evidence endpoints so valid trailing gaps remain measurable without allowing caller-invented or author-controlled future horizons.
fail_closed: If a promotion request supplies observed_through later than the trusted durable horizon, reject that promotion request as UNTRUSTED_OBSERVATION_HORIZON. Do not shorten a valid trusted horizon to the latest useful-evidence endpoint. Git commit author/committer timestamps are author-controlled metadata and MUST NOT establish a trusted external observation boundary.
